post-header: Spotted a pothole? Here is the fastest way to get it on the repair list.
post-body:
Potholes form when water seeps into cracks, freezes, and expands. Reports from the public help crews prioritize repairs.

When you report, note the nearest address or cross street, which lane the pothole is in, and its approximate size. A photo helps if you can take one safely.

post-header: Reduced speed limits in work zones protect workers and drivers alike.
post-body:
Work zone speed limits are in effect whenever posted, whether or not workers are visible. Fines may be higher in active work zones.

Slow down, increase following distance, and watch for flaggers and sudden lane shifts.

post-header: Building or changing a driveway onto a public road usually requires a permit.
post-body:
An access permit makes sure new driveways meet sight-distance, drainage, and safety requirements.

Applications typically include a site plan, property information, and a description of the work. Review times vary by agency.
